name: prayerapp-firebase
description: Firebase backend for the prayer app: security rules, rules tests, (later) Cloud Functions

scripts.emulators: npm --prefix functions run build && firebase emulators:start --only auth,firestore,storage,functions --project demo-prayerapp
scripts.test:sandbox: SKIP_CROSS_SERVICE=1 firebase emulators:exec --only firestore,storage --project demo-prayerapp "vitest run"
